requirementWeight: 0.45 divided equally among all request-derived explicit requirements
scores: Each criterion has separate integer A and B scores from 0 through 4
orderPolicy: Independent AB and BA aggregates, swapped game mapped to original candidate labels
tiePolicy: A tie or unknown score is wrong under the official benchmark metric
selectionInputs: DEV request shapes and the owner's decomposition instruction; no fit to suspect labels
scoringInputs: Request, its blind-derived criteria, complete candidate texts
scoringModes: paired: separately scored criteria with both candidates present
independent: each reply alone; criteria and candidate processing orders both reversed

v2.authority: Owner: extract criteria once per prompt, score all criteria for one reply in one call, reasoning before numbers; target under $1.50/100; measure 10 DEV cases first.
v2.orderPolicy: Independent scorecards reused for code comparisons in both orders; no extra judge confidence is inferred from reuse.
v2.costAccounting: Unique exact-prompt recipe costs, including setup once per writing request; record new spend separately.
v2.qualityFix: Retain exact names and threat modality in blind extraction; final reasoning precedes score fields.

newContractReviewStatus: Independent re-review running; owner authorizes full run and freeze.

changes: mandatory flag excludes optional requirements from arithmetic
no invented title delimiters, platform markers, citations or viewpoints
quality distinguishes assertion from realized experience and responsible unknowns
v3.pilotGate: strictly greater than 45% on the same ten pairs before full DEV; freeze holistic if no fix ready by 03:45 Brussels
